'''Flass''' was a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceriun]] about [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and the son of [[Morro]], the headman of [[Drop Canyon]] village. He was an associate of [[Tenno]], taking part in his plan to take possession of a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that a [[Unidentified Jedi (Ceriun)|dying Jedi Knight]] had passed on to the village elders and turn it over to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in exchange for passage offworld.

When Tenno lost his nerve after killing his father, [[Ka'arn]], Flass took charge and ordered Morro to stand aside and hand over the holocron. When Morro defied him angrily, Flass killed his father with his axe, precipitating a brawl between Tenno's gang and the elders. The fight was interrupted by a [[Unidentified tattooed Sith|Sith Lord]] who took the holocron for himself and contemptuously slew Flass with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
